what_happened: Research for task 426 confirmed DEFECT C's exact failure pattern (handoff_dispatch_seq empty by construction in a no-handoff branch, correct value is expected_dispatch_seq) also appears structurally at the OTHER issue-record.sh call sites inside orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's post-handoff-read case statement (partial/failed|blocked/off-schema arms) whenever reached via the return-meta-recovery path rather than the handoff-present path -- handoff_dispatch_seq is assigned at exactly one site (the handoff-present branch) so any of those arms reached via recovery also silently omit --dispatch-seq. Out of this task's scope (scoped to the absent-handoff/RECOVERY_DECLINED path only per its dispatch), but worth a follow-up task: the dispatch-metrics.sh call site at this same file already fixes this correctly and documents why ("deliberately NOT $handoff_dispatch_seq, which is empty on the recovery path").

test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's setup_sandbox never copies issue-record.sh or dispatch-metrics.sh into the fixture's .claude/scripts/ tree, even though orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh calls both non-fatally throughout its RECOVERY_DECLINED and other case arms. Every existing fixture is therefore structurally unable to observe issues.jsonl content (the calls silently no-op against a missing executable, caught by the existing || echo Note fallback) -- this task's own VERIFY items (1) and (2), which require asserting a RECOVERY_DECLINED issues.jsonl entry's phase and dispatch_seq fields, cannot be satisfied without first extending setup_sandbox's two file-copy lists to add issue-record.sh (its own dependencies -- common.sh, deploy-root-guard.sh, lib/task-lookup-lib.sh -- are already copied).

Research report's primary recommendation (hoist the strand-probe capture and stall commit-count above the RECOVERY_DECLINED arm and REMOVE the later computation) was found unsafe at plan-authoring time: WORK (i)'s per-task scoped commit sits at line ~1843, between the proposed hoist target (~line 1006) and the canonical stall/stranded computation (~2154/~2204). On a RECOVERY_DECLINED cycle the task dir is dirty, so WORK (i) can land a commit inside the dispatch window; hoist-and-remove would therefore silently change both emitted fields' values. Plan replaces it with arm-local, separately-named record-time annotation values, leaving both canonical blocks byte-identical.

Research report's line-level control-flow map (defect-by-defect, with exact line numbers and the dispatch-metrics.sh precedent comment for DEFECT C) made Phases 1 and 2 plannable with only confirmatory greps -- no re-derivation needed. The test-harness gap it surfaced (issue-record.sh absent from both sandbox copy lists) prevented authoring two VERIFY items that would have been unsatisfiable as written.
